verifiedProduct.capability: Real Tauri v2 application verification through Ferrum's existing provider-neutral W3C WebDriver runner.

realRuntimeAcceptance: build and launch pinned real Tauri v2 app on Linux and Windows

failureHistory: mixed Tauri runtime family blocked an earlier build
tauri-build 2.6.0 was incompatible with Tauri 2.11.5 and was corrected to 2.6.3
Windows embedded capability generation required deterministic JSON escaping for Windows paths
direct official Windows tauri-driver remains diagnostic because WebView2/msedgedriver can fail before session creation

ecosystemRotation: native desktop accessibility, agent-first desktop control, Windows UI automation, W3C desktop drivers and compact semantic agent surfaces

researchConclusion.topExperiment: Run one deterministic Windows application workload through Microsoft winappCli, Appium Desktop Driver 2.4.5 and NovaWindows 1.4.4 with identical actions and evidence requirements.
harvest: stable HWND/window identity and semantic UIA selectors
separate headless UIA-pattern actions from real-input actions
compact agent surfaces with full raw UIA/page-source/screenshot evidence
keep vision and MCP companions optional
researchConclusion.independentChallenge: No second product change was made because native Windows candidates still require an identical-workload real Windows differential.

nextExperiments: Native Windows differential: winappCli vs Appium Desktop Driver 2.4.5 vs NovaWindows 1.4.4 on one deterministic real Windows app, recording success, setup time, median/p95 action latency, tool/schema bytes, stale-target handling, restart/reattach, evidence completeness and cleanup.
If one provider wins, integrate through the narrowest stable Ferrum adapter contract and keep provider-specific MCP/vision packages optional.
After native Windows convergence, revisit a one-call desktop state envelope using compact semantic refs without removing raw UIA/page-source/screenshot evidence.
guardrails: Tauri support is only claimed through the exact real Linux and Windows embedded W3C acceptance path that passed.
Official Windows tauri-driver remains diagnostic and is not treated as passing cross-platform authority.

No existing Linux, Windows browser matrix, MV3 restart, Spaces, Workbench, Electron, packaged desktop, Lightpanda, Android/Appium, MCP, WebDriver, API/service or evidence capability was removed or weakened.
Native Windows candidates remain off product code until an identical-workload real-runtime comparison proves the winner.
